# What a live fence's mistakes say, and where. The position a checker would
# report is the `import` that read the document, which says nothing about where
# in it the fence was written -- so the importer names the markdown file and the
# line itself.

# A mode nobody defined, named where it was written.
! sngl check typo.sngl
stderr 'typo.md:3: unknown fence mode "islnd"'
stderr 'view, island, package or body'

# A mode on a fence in some other language. A mode says what to compile the
# source as, and this compiler compiles one language.
! sngl check other_language.sngl
stderr 'other_language.md:1: mode=island on a "go" fence'

# A live fence that does not parse reports at the fence, not at the import.
! sngl check broken.sngl
stderr 'broken.md:1:'
stderr 'unexpected'

# Two islands claiming one alias for two packages is not renamed here:
# rewriting an alias means resolving every name under it, which is checking, and
# this importer emits source for the checker rather than doing its work. So it
# reaches the checker as the program it is, and the diagnostic is the one any
# program writing two such imports gets -- named against the generated file,
# which is the cost of the decision and is why `document.sngl` appears here.
! sngl check alias_conflict.sngl
stderr 'document.sngl'
stderr '"x" is already bound at file scope by an import alias'

# A trailer the importer does not recognise is left alone: the info line is
# shared vocabulary, and refusing `title=` would turn a document that renders
# on every other site into a build failure. So this is an ordinary fence.
sngl check other_trailer.sngl
stdout 'ok'

-- typo.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import doc "md:./typo.md"

ui.window #home(title="t") {
    doc.document
}

output {
    none {
        html
    }
}
-- typo.md --
Some words.

```sngl mode=islnd
ui.text(value="a")
```
-- other_language.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import doc "md:./other_language.md"

ui.window #home(title="t") {
    doc.document
}

output {
    none {
        html
    }
}
-- other_language.md --
```go mode=island
package main
```
-- broken.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import doc "md:./broken.md"

ui.window #home(title="t") {
    doc.document
}

output {
    none {
        html
    }
}
-- broken.md --
```sngl mode=body
ui.text(value=
```
-- other_trailer.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import doc "md:./other_trailer.md"

ui.window #home(title="t") {
    doc.document
}

output {
    none {
        html
    }
}
-- other_trailer.md --
```sngl title="an example"
const n = 1
```
-- alias_conflict.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import doc "md:./alias_conflict.md"

ui.window #home(title="t") {
    doc.document
}

output {
    none {
        html
    }
}
-- alias_conflict.md --
```sngl mode=island
import x "sngl:ui"

x.text(value="a")
```

```sngl mode=island
import x "sngl:seq"

ui.text(value="{x.count(2)}")
```
